title: Meridian Databricks Consumption Commit Demo Evidence Pack
pii_phi_handling: Synthetic, PHI-free, planning-grade Databricks consumption commitment and contract evidence package. No patient, member, provider, claim-line, PHI, PII, real production records, real Databricks transactions, or real pricing exhibits are included. Raw/full Databricks contract documents and pricing exhibits remain outside the public repository in local restricted storage.
notes: Manifest gates the repo-staged source-file package at datasets/source/cloud-consumption/meridian-databricks-consumption-commit-v1-20260908. It authorizes only a controlled operator ACA data-build job with row-count reconciliation, quality-gate output, proof bundle, and live retrieval proof before Source, Tower, or aVa claims rely on the package. The 173-object count is 167 CSV source rows plus 6 synthetic evidence documents. Databricks is named as the real vendor in a fictional Meridian Health demo case; all economics, dates, clauses, documents, opportunities, and workbook values are synthetic and not finance-confirmed.
